summary: Creatd, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a binding September 30, 2026 letter of intent to acquire all outstanding equity, options and warrants of C2 Capital Group, Inc., a company in which Creatd already holds a minority interest. Consideration is newly issued Creatd common stock plus a new series of non-voting convertible preferred stock totaling roughly 12,900,000 common-equivalent shares; no price per share, premium or value is stated. Closing requires a definitive agreement and customary conditions, with reciprocal break-up fees in specified circumstances. Watch definitive-agreement execution, preferred terms and conversion mechanics, and dilution/overhang for arbitrage.
